resources.string: Fires when a watch setting changes, including changes made on the watch. Settings are shared by all watches, so this event carries no watch. Pick a preference and, optionally, the value it must change to.
Fires once per watch and offered firmware version, when the Pebble app finds an update.

Fires when a screenshot or log dump requested by this plugin finishes. The file at %pbl_uri is readable only by this plugin and is deleted after an hour; use the Take Screenshot or Gather Watch Logs actions to save a copy.

Checks the watch features Tasker can drive, through the installed Pebble app: time sync, screenshots, buttons, touch, apps, preferences, firmware, logs and (optionally) reboot. Nothing is reinstalled.

The checks press buttons on the watch, briefly toggle Quiet Time, and launch and close an app. Reboot runs only if you switch it on. Factory reset is never run. Needs the dangerous tier and "Allow dangerous commands" in the Pebble app; the log check also needs the extremely dangerous tier.
Watch serial (blank = the only connected watch)
App to launch (optional; blank = from the locker)
